name: a human gets tired, sleeps through the night in a bed, and is up in the morning

steps.note: the bed sits in cell (3, 3): x 3*48+24, y 3*48+24
paused, so the only ticks this world takes are the ones asked for below

steps.shot: a bedroom with nobody in it

steps.note: hunger, thirst, a bladder and boredom switched off, so this is a test about
being tired rather than a race between five needs on a map with a bed and
nothing else in it. Energy is the one left running, and its level was rolled

steps.shot: the debug menu at eight in the morning: stamina, and energy among the processes

steps.note: a world opens at eight in the morning. A waking day is sixteen hours of world
and the night starts at ten, so 19 hours in is three in the morning: 1920 ticks
to the hour. Whenever this one was going to get tired it has been to bed by now

steps.shot: three in the morning: in bed, and what its mind is doing

steps.note: night ends at six and eight in the morning is 24 hours in. Whoever was in bed
by three has had five hours or more of it, which is a night's worth of rest

steps.shot: eight the next morning: up, and what its mind is doing
